notes: Updates now recognise Inkwell in any folder its installer used, so installations in a folder of your own update in place too.
Ctrl+Shift+E turns track changes on and off, as in Word; Export moves to Ctrl+Shift+X, and Alt+F opens the menu.
Settings › Autocorrect lists every rule, Markdown shortcuts included, so a rule stopped from the chip can be turned back on.
A correction made as you press Enter shows its chip and is undone by one Ctrl+Z.
The command bar shortens in whole steps on narrow windows instead of cutting labels off.
Start at… on the right-click menu and in the palette; .docm documents save automatically; version history follows a new size limit straight away.
